Assisted-by: OpenAI Codex

## Motivation

In paged full-attention + Mamba serving, [truncated prefill chunks](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/6cac4dc3fe9a4bf15009f300132c3c7a1853c210/python/sglang/srt/managers/schedule_policy.py#L1100-L1160) can end inside a KV page. A Mamba checkpoint at token 287 and a radix key ending at page boundary 272 can then both free page 34. [PR #39526](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39526) addresses checkpoint tracking, not chunk alignment.

## Modifications

Align truncated hybrid chunks to KV pages; defer if no full page fits. Keep final, untruncated tails unchanged. No user-facing documentation changes are needed.

## Accuracy Tests

- A historical parallel-sampling run hit a duplicate page free before the fix, but not in matched fixed runs; unchecked outputs were unchanged.
- On main `2e7c9d851c`, the prefill-adder suite passed `58/58` with a `datasets` stub. On the fix branch, two current-main serving waves completed four parallel-sampling requests with 2, 3, 4, and 2 samples; all HTTP calls and post-run probes returned 200 with the native KV-page invariant checker enabled. This is a serving smoke test, not a matched output comparison; the local kernel-version guard was bypassed because `sglang-kernel` 0.4.5 is older than main requires.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RTX A6000, Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base: two warmed baseline/fix pairs, each with three 40-request rounds at concurrency 4. For 2–4 parallel samples, output throughput was 1,353–1,396 vs. 1,325–1,413 tok/s (baseline vs. fix); p95 HTTP latency also overlapped. No consistent speed change was observed. The historical failure did not trigger during this benchmark.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -831,6 +831,14 @@ def _request_slot_reserve_for_req(
     def ceil_paged_tokens(self, tokens: int) -> int:
         return -(-tokens // self.page_size) * self.page_size
 
+    def _align_truncated_hybrid_chunk(self, prefix_len: int, chunk_len: int) -> int:
+        if not self.is_hybrid_ssm_cache or self.page_size == 1:
+            return chunk_len
+        # A Mamba checkpoint and its paged full-KV key must end at the same
+        # physical page boundary. Final, untruncated tails remain unrestricted.
+        end = (prefix_len + chunk_len) // self.page_size * self.page_size
+        return max(end - prefix_len, 0)
+
     def budget_state(self):
         no_token = not self.memory_budget.has_capacity()
         # Gate new mamba slots separately: rem_total_tokens' full_evictable can't
@@ -1140,6 +1148,10 @@ def add_chunked_req(self, req: Req):
             return req
         truncated = cand_extend_input_len > _rem_tokens
         new_len = min(cand_extend_input_len, _rem_tokens)
+        if truncated:
+            new_len = self._align_truncated_hybrid_chunk(req.prefix_len, new_len)
+            if new_len <= 0:
+                return req
         request_slot_reserve = self._request_slot_reserve_for_req(
             req, extend_input_len=new_len
         )
@@ -1312,7 +1324,11 @@ def add_req_state(r, insert_sort=False):
                 return AddReqResult.OTHER
 
             # Chunked prefill
-            trunc_len = self.rem_chunk_tokens
+            trunc_len = self._align_truncated_hybrid_chunk(
+                req.prefix_len, self.rem_chunk_tokens
+            )
+            if trunc_len <= 0:
+                return AddReqResult.OTHER
 
             if (tile_stop := self._check_prefill_tile_budget(trunc_len)) is not None:
                 return tile_stop

@@ -74,6 +74,7 @@ def create_tree_cache(
         tree_cache.full_evictable_size.return_value = full_evictable_size
         tree_cache.swa_evictable_size.return_value = swa_evictable_size
         tree_cache.evictable_size.return_value = evictable_size
+        tree_cache.supports_mamba.return_value = False
         tree_cache.disable = False
         tree_cache.inc_lock_ref.return_value = IncLockRefResult()
         tree_cache.dec_lock_ref.return_value = DecLockRefResult()
@@ -470,6 +471,59 @@ def test_shared_continuation_defers_when_decode_consumes_chunk_budget(self):
                     before,
                 )
 
+    def test_hybrid_mamba_continuation_ends_on_full_kv_page(self):
+        self.mock_tree_cache.supports_mamba.return_value = True
+        self.mock_token_allocator.available_size.return_value = 10000
+        adder = self.create_adder(
+            self.create_running_batch(), page_size=16, rem_chunk_tokens=123
+        )
+        req = self.create_mock_req("continuation", priority=0, max_new_tokens=0)
+        req.prefix_len = 128
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = list(range(307))
+
+        self.assertIs(adder.add_chunked_req(req), req)
+        self.assertEqual(req.extend_end, 240)
+
+    def test_hybrid_mamba_ignore_eos_prime_ends_on_full_kv_page(self):
+        self.mock_tree_cache.supports_mamba.return_value = True
+        self.mock_token_allocator.available_size.return_value = 10000
+        adder = self.create_adder(
+            self.create_running_batch(), page_size=16, rem_chunk_tokens=123
+        )
+        req = self.create_mock_req("prime", priority=0, max_new_tokens=0)
+        req.sampling_params.ignore_eos = True
+        req.origin_input_ids = list(range(307))
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = list(range(307))
+
+        adder.add_one_req_ignore_eos(req)
+        self.assertEqual(req.extend_end, 112)
+
+    def test_hybrid_mamba_continuation_defers_without_full_page(self):
+        self.mock_tree_cache.supports_mamba.return_value = True
+        self.mock_token_allocator.available_size.return_value = 10000
+        adder = self.create_adder(
+            self.create_running_batch(), page_size=16, rem_chunk_tokens=15
+        )
+        req = self.create_mock_req("continuation", priority=0, max_new_tokens=0)
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = list(range(307))
+
+        self.assertIs(adder.add_chunked_req(req), req)
+        self.assertIsNone(req.extend_end)
+        self.assertEqual(adder.can_run_list, [])
+
+    def test_hybrid_mamba_continuation_keeps_untruncated_tail(self):
+        self.mock_tree_cache.supports_mamba.return_value = True
+        self.mock_token_allocator.available_size.return_value = 10000
+        adder = self.create_adder(
+            self.create_running_batch(), page_size=16, rem_chunk_tokens=123
+        )
+        req = self.create_mock_req("tail", priority=0, max_new_tokens=0)
+        req.prefix_len = 128
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = list(range(143))
+
+        self.assertIsNone(adder.add_chunked_req(req))
+        self.assertEqual(req.extend_end, 143)
+
     def test_shared_continuation_uses_memory_chunk_limit(self):
         adder = self.create_shared_adder()
         req = self.create_shared_req("continuation", max_new_tokens=80)
